name: Shenzhen Jdd Tech New Material Co Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Jdd Tech New Material Co., Ltd., founded in Shenzhen, China, in 2004, is a company dedicated to the comprehensive process of researching, designing, developing, manufacturing, and distributing advanced modified polymer protective materials. Their core offerings encompass a diverse portfolio of functional protective sleeves and specialized monofilaments. The company's extensive product line features a wide array of tapes, including cloth, fiber, and PVC varieties, alongside specialized connectors like waterproof cable and metal joints. They produce various tubing and conduit solutions, such as flexible Teflon bellows, tinned copper braided mesh, corrugated and spiral conduits, metal-coated hoses, and a broad selection of heat-shrinkable and expandable sleeves crafted from materials like polyester, nylon, PPS, and high-abrasion PET. Furthermore, Jdd Tech supplies numerous protective wraps, encompassing aluminum heat-reflective fiberglass, various hook-and-loop designs, silent braided options, self-closing polyester and waved wraps, and a range of zipper-based multifilament and carpet wraps. Additional products include high-durability woven network management, aluminum foil bellows, sealing strips, winding tubes, single-layer glass fiber tubes, zipper shielding sleeves, aluminum fiber glass tube foils, and carbon fiber casing products. These advanced protective solutions are widely utilized in critical industries such as automotive manufacturing, engineering machinery, railway systems, and communication electronics, among others.
